lines.en: I crawl forward one segment at a time.
My little feet grip the leaf veins.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶子边缘慢慢挪。
lines.en: I inch along the leaf edge.
The leaf sways, and I sway with it.
I lift my head to feel ahead.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子，还够我吃一阵。
lines.en: This leaf will feed me a while.
I crawl under the leaf where it's cool.
I move and pause, very careful.

lines.zh: 我想爬到旁边那片叶子。
lines.en: I want to reach the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我的身体一拱一拱地动。
lines.en: My body humps along as I go.
I creep toward the twig's end.
When the wind blows, I cling to a vein.
I crawl down the stem.
I find a tender leaf and stop.
I hang myself on the leaf tip.
I cross the whole leaf surface.
I press flat to the leaf, still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢磨碎一片叶，声音很细。
lines.en: I grind a leaf slowly, a very fine sound.
I curl up and pass for a bud.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤和叶子颜色很近。
lines.en: My skin is close to the leaf's color.
I pause and listen to the tree.

lines.zh: 我一天大部分时间都在吃。
lines.en: I spend most of the day eating.

lines.zh: 我抬头看上面那层的叶。
lines.en: I look up at the leaves above.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶子照到我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the leaf onto me.
I hold still, afraid of falling.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完之前，我哪也不去。
lines.en: Not leaving until this leaf is gone.
I coil my body by the midrib.
The leaf is soft and reassuring.
You're so big; don't crush the leaf.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，量你的高度。
lines.en: I rear up and measure your height.
I'm on the leaf, you're below.
You reach a finger; I shrink back.
This leaf is my dinner plate.
Don't take the leaf; I'd starve.
I tilt my head and study you slowly.

lines.zh: 你可以把我搬到别的叶上。
lines.en: You could move me to another leaf.
I won't bite you; I eat leaves.

lines.zh: 我在叶背抬头，与你对看。
lines.en: I raise my head under the leaf and meet your eyes.
I curl into a ring.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的身体都弯了。
lines.en: That bent my whole body.

lines.zh: 我从叶缘滑了半寸，抓紧了。
lines.en: I slipped half an inch at the leaf edge and caught hold.
I pull my head back into the second segment.
A little fluid seeps from me.
I slowly uncurl.

lines.zh: 这片叶子还在，我就还好。
lines.en: The leaf is still here, so I'm fine.
I hide under the leaf.
I can still crawl, only slowly.
Don't touch me again.
A leaf! A fresh leaf!

lines.zh: 你把叶子放到我面前了。
lines.en: You've set a leaf before me.
This leaf smells tender.
I crawl over slowly.
Don't pull it away; I haven't bitten.
This bite satisfies me.
Give me a new leaf and I'll move.
I open my mouthparts and taste.
With a leaf, I'm at ease.
One more leaf and I can grow.

lines.zh: 你碰到叶子，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You bumped the leaf and I swayed.
I gripped the vein and didn't fall.
Don't tip the leaf over.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你几乎碰不到。
lines.en: I'm so small you barely touch me.
When the leaf sways, I stop.
I cling tightly; I won't drop.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩下来，我贴紧叶面。
lines.en: Your shadow falls; I press flat to the leaf.
I shift toward the leaf's underside.
I pull in half a segment, then stretch out.
I crawl back to my old spot.
Another caterpillar is right nearby.

lines.zh: 两条绿虫并排，节律一致。
lines.en: Two green caterpillars side by side, moving in rhythm.
Its markings are a shade deeper.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢靠近，触须相碰。
lines.en: We draw closer, antennae touching.
The pupating season is near.
We press our bodies together.
This leaf is enough for both.
We rest together on the midrib.
The wind comes; we sway together.

lines.zh: 再过一阵，我们都要变了。
lines.en: Soon we'll both change.

lines.zh: 我这几节身子，夹不住东西。
lines.en: These segments can't pinch anything up.
I nudge it with my mouthparts.
I'll eat even these leaf scraps.
It's between me and the leaf.
I crawl around it.

lines.zh: 叶子啃出一个洞，正好藏身。
lines.en: The hole I chewed makes good cover.
The leaf is what I want.
I crawl slowly over that thing.
It's too hard; I can't bite it.
I retreat to the leaf.
I want that leaf.
I crawl toward the tender leaves.
This one's old; the next is better.
I've chosen a leaf.
That vein leads to dinner.
My hind segments move first; the rest follows.
No one is eating that one up ahead.
Just that little piece.
I'm hungry; I must get there.
The direction is clear.
I approach segment by segment.
A little further and I'll reach.
I crawl along the leaf edge.
A midrib lies between us.
I slowly cross the leaf.
That leaf sways gently.
No hurry; crawling will do.
I go around a small water bead.
It's right ahead.
A little more and I'm there.

lines.zh: 我用绿色的头顶了顶叶梗。
lines.en: I butt the leaf stalk with my green head.
I bite the stem and tug.
My strength is only enough for leaves.
That bit through the leaf.
I push at what blocks me.
My mouthparts are tiny; I can't bite deep.
I shake my head once.

lines.zh: 这点动静，你大概没感觉。
lines.en: You probably felt nothing.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘被我啃成锯齿。
lines.en: I chewed the leaf edge into teeth.
I'm tired; I stop to rest.
I've chewed out of the egg.
I've landed on this leaf.

lines.zh: 细带翠蛱蝶的毛虫，在这。
lines.en: A commander caterpillar, here.

lines.zh: 破壳第一口，就是脚下的叶。
lines.en: My first bite after hatching is the leaf beneath me.
This leaf was given to me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看看这个新世界。
lines.en: I raise my head to this new world.
I'm not yet a butterfly.
I crawl slowly onto a new shoot.

lines.zh: 森林里有很多这样的叶。
lines.en: There are many leaves like this in the forest.

lines.zh: 我先找一处安全的叶背。
lines.en: First I find a safe leaf underside.

lines.zh: 热气一烘，我的身体都干了。
lines.en: The heat dries my whole body.

lines.zh: 叶子一翻，我掉进了草里。
lines.en: The leaf flipped and I fell into the grass.
Water soaks me until I can't move.

lines.zh: 我被气流吹得滚下叶子。
lines.en: The blast rolls me off the leaf.
An arrow grazes my leaf.

lines.zh: 光一照，我的绿皮泛起白点。
lines.en: The light makes white spots rise on my green skin.

lines.zh: 没有叶子，我快撑不住了。
lines.en: Without a leaf, I'm fading.
The thunder shakes every leaf.
There are no leaves to eat here.
